vb_textbox.text: Hi, the green hatted gnome seemed to give a favourable outcome towards the start of the game but it did become unreliable for a time. Towards the end of the game the brown hatted gnome gave a good outcome and the green one seemed to give a higher level of mushrooms again so I basically chose either of those two when they came up as options. Otherwise, in the middle of the game I more relied on instinct.
